say:3:1422604002:1.text: Alright, let me first introduce myself. I'm Zanie, and I'm currently the chief tinkerer of all things crafted here in dear Brimstone Village.
say:3:1422604002:1.source_cn: 好嘞！我先来介绍下，我叫祖娅，目前深岩村的——嗯，技术...

say:4:1422604003:0.text: It's an honor to meet you, Miss Zanie. General Hogan and Magister Merlin have already told me about you. You're a technological genius with ideas that are ahead of your time.
say:4:1422604003:0.source_cn: 很荣幸见到您，祖娅女士。霍根将军和梅林大人已经为我介绍...
say:4:1422604003:0.male: It's an honor to meet you, Miss Zanie. General Hogan and Magister Merlin have already told me about you. You're a technological genius with ideas that are ahead of your time.
say:4:1422604003:0.female: It's an honor to meet you, Miss Zanie. General Hogan and Magister Merlin have already told me about you. You're a technological genius with ideas that are ahead of your time.

say:5:1422604004:0.text: Moreover, it was with your assistance that General Hogan was able to escape safely.
say:5:1422604004:0.source_cn: 而且，也正是在您的协助下，霍根将军才能安然无恙地从地下脱险。

say:6:1422604005:0.text: That was nothing. Oh, here, let me introduce you to Hyla, the person now in charge of Brimstone Village!
say:6:1422604005:0.source_cn: 哪里哪里，只是些不值一提的小工作罢了——来，这位是海拉...

say:8:1422604006:0.text: Greetings, it's a pleasure to meet you, Madam Envoy.
say:8:1422604006:0.source_cn: 您好，很荣幸见到您，特使女士。

say:9:1422604007:0.text: I heard that you're interested in our newly developed materials and processes. I'll show you around and introduce you to what we've been up to.
say:9:1422604007:0.source_cn: 听说您对新开发的材料与工艺有兴趣，因此我会随行，从专业...

say:10:1422604008:0.text: Greetings, I've heard of you. You're the weapons expert in Brimstone Village and a renowned blacksmith.
say:10:1422604008:0.source_cn: 您好，我听说过您的名字，深岩村此前武器的负责专家以及知...

say:11:1422604009:0.text: When you were still accepting private commissions, any sword of your craft and your signature was beyond valuable.
say:11:1422604009:0.source_cn: 在您还接手私人工作的时候，一把有您署名的宝剑可是有价无市。

say:12:1422604010:0.text: You're too kind. That was many years ago...
say:12:1422604010:0.source_cn: 啊，您太客气了，那是很多年以前的事了……

say:13:1422604011:0.text: Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. You can just call me Evie. Is it okay if I refer to you two by your names?
say:13:1422604011:0.source_cn: 对了，我这边还没有自我介绍呢。叫我伊芙就可以，我也能直...

say:14:1422604012:1.text: Go ahead, Evie! So, is there anything you want to check out?
say:14:1422604012:1.source_cn: 那就不客气了，伊芙，你有什么想看的地方吗？

say:15:1422604013:0.text: Well, there are many. Some things may seem a bit trivial...
say:15:1422604013:0.source_cn: 嗯，有许多，可能会有些琐碎——

say:16:1422604014:0.text: Don't worry about it. Just tell us and we'll do our best to assist.
say:16:1422604014:0.source_cn: 请放心吧，我们一定会全力协助。

narration:17:1422604015:0.text: Evie, Zanie, and Hyla are chatting off to the side, sunlight dancing on their focused expressions. Looks like a perfect time to catch up with Chippy and Hammie.
narration:17:1422604015:0.source_cn: 伊芙、祖娅和海拉在一旁交谈，日光映照着她们专注的面孔，...
